title: Arabic Expression
subtitle: Build skill in written and spoken Arabic self-expression
description: A three-level journey through At-Ta'bīr (Arabic Expression/Composition) — from simple self-introduction and daily-life sentences, through structured description, narration, and opinion-with-reasoning, to full argumentative essays, advanced discourse connectors, and formal speech.

difficulties.label: Beginner
difficulties.description: Simple, correct sentences about yourself, your surroundings, and your day

questions.text: Which technique helps the reader "see" through comparison, e.g. عَيْنَاهَا كَالْبَحْرِ ("her eyes were like the sea")?

questions.text: Which phrase introduces a specific supporting detail, meaning "for example"?

stages.title: Ar-Ra'y wal-Ḥujjah — Opinion with Reasoning

questions.text: Which structure best supports an opinion with a clear reason: "I believe reading is important because it broadens the mind"?

questions.answer: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ الْقِرَاءَةَ مُهِمَّةٌ لِأَنَّهَا تُوَسِّعُ الْعَقْلَ

لِأَنَّ الشَّوَارِعَ غَرِقَتْ، كَانَ الْمَطَرُ غَزِيرًا
questions.answer: لِأَنَّ الْمَطَرَ كَانَ غَزِيرًا، غَرِقَتِ الشَّوَارِعُ

questions.text: Which phrase means "due to / because of" (used with a noun, not a full clause)?
Which phrase introduces a logical consequence, "therefore / thus"?
Which sentence best explains a chain of cause and effect: "Pollution increases, therefore diseases increase, and as a result, healthcare costs rise"?
options: يَزْدَادُ التَّلَوُّثُ، وَبِالتَّالِي تَزْدَادُ الْأَمْرَاضُ، وَنَتِيجَةً لِذَلِكَ تَرْتَفِعُ تَكَالِيفُ الرِّعَايَةِ الصِّحِّيَّةِ
تَرْتَفِعُ تَكَالِيفُ الرِّعَايَةِ الصِّحِّيَّةِ لِذَلِكَ يَزْدَادُ التَّلَوُّثُ
questions.answer: يَزْدَادُ التَّلَوُّثُ، وَبِالتَّالِي تَزْدَادُ الْأَمْرَاضُ، وَنَتِيجَةً لِذَلِكَ تَرْتَفِعُ تَكَالِيفُ الرِّعَايَةِ الصِّحِّيَّةِ

stages.title: At-Ta'bīr 'an al-Mashā'ir al-Mu'aqqadah — Complex Emotions
stages.description: Expressing mixed, nuanced, or conflicted feelings

questions.text: Which sentence expresses a mixed feeling: "I am happy for you, but I also feel a little sad"?
options: أَنَا سَعِيدٌ مِنْ أَجْلِكَ، لَكِنِّي أَشْعُرُ بِقَلِيلٍ مِنَ الْحُزْنِ أَيْضًا
أَنَا سَعِيدٌ فَقَط، لَا حُزْنَ عِنْدِي
أَنَا حَزِينٌ فَقَط، لَا سَعَادَةَ عِنْدِي
لَا أَشْعُرُ بِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ تِجَاهَ هَذَا
questions.answer: أَنَا سَعِيدٌ مِنْ أَجْلِكَ، لَكِنِّي أَشْعُرُ بِقَلِيلٍ مِنَ الْحُزْنِ أَيْضًا

questions.text: Which phrase expresses nostalgia, "I long for..."?
Which sentence expresses hesitation: "I don't know whether to accept this offer or not"?
options: لَا أَعْرِفُ هَلْ أَقْبَلُ هَذَا الْعَرْضَ أَمْ لَا
أَنَا مُتَأَكِّدٌ أَنِّي سَأَقْبَلُ هَذَا الْعَرْضَ
questions.answer: لَا أَعْرِفُ هَلْ أَقْبَلُ هَذَا الْعَرْضَ أَمْ لَا

questions.text: Which word best captures the feeling of being torn between two choices?
Which sentence expresses gratitude mixed with humility: "I am deeply grateful, though I feel I don't deserve this much kindness"?
options: أَنَا مُمْتَنٌّ جِدًّا، وَإِنْ كُنْتُ أَشْعُرُ أَنِّي لَا أَسْتَحِقُّ كُلَّ هَذَا اللُّطْفِ
أَنَا مُمْتَنٌّ جِدًّا وَأَسْتَحِقُّ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
questions.answer: أَنَا مُمْتَنٌّ جِدًّا، وَإِنْ كُنْتُ أَشْعُرُ أَنِّي لَا أَسْتَحِقُّ كُلَّ هَذَا اللُّطْفِ

stages.title: Kitābat al-Fiqrah — Paragraph Structure
stages.description: Topic sentence, support, and conclusion

questions.text: What are the three essential parts of a well-formed paragraph?
options: Topic sentence, supporting sentences, concluding sentence
Only a title and a date
questions.answer: Topic sentence, supporting sentences, concluding sentence

questions.text: Which sentence is the best topic sentence for a paragraph about the benefits of exercise?
options: لِلرِّيَاضَةِ فَوَائِدُ عَدِيدَةٌ عَلَى الْجِسْمِ وَالْعَقْلِ
أَنَا أَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ الْقَدَمِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
questions.answer: لِلرِّيَاضَةِ فَوَائِدُ عَدِيدَةٌ عَلَى الْجِسْمِ وَالْعَقْلِ

questions.text: Which sentence functions as a strong concluding sentence for that same paragraph?
options: لِذَلِكَ، مِنَ الْمُهِمِّ أَنْ نُمَارِسَ الرِّيَاضَةَ بِانْتِظَامٍ
questions.answer: لِذَلِكَ، مِنَ الْمُهِمِّ أَنْ نُمَارِسَ الرِّيَاضَةَ بِانْتِظَامٍ

questions.text: Which supporting sentence best fits within the exercise paragraph?
What is "coherence" (الِاتِّسَاق) in paragraph writing?
options: The logical, smooth flow of ideas connected by appropriate linking words
Using as many big words as possible
Repeating the same word many times
questions.answer: The logical, smooth flow of ideas connected by appropriate linking words

stages.title: Al-Ḥiwār — Dialogue Writing
stages.description: Writing natural, responsive exchanges between speakers

questions.text: Which line reflects a polite disagreement: "I understand your point, but I see it differently"?
options: أَفْهَمُ وِجْهَةَ نَظَرِكَ، لَكِنِّي أَرَى الْأَمْرَ بِشَكْلٍ مُخْتَلِفٍ
أَنْتَ مُخْطِئٌ تَمَامًا وَلَا أُرِيدُ سَمَاعَ رَأْيِكَ
questions.answer: أَفْهَمُ وِجْهَةَ نَظَرِكَ، لَكِنِّي أَرَى الْأَمْرَ بِشَكْلٍ مُخْتَلِفٍ

questions.text: In a dialogue about planning a trip, which line best asks for the other's input?
options: مَا رَأْيُكَ فِيمَا يَجِبُ أَنْ نَفْعَلَهُ أَوَّلًا؟
questions.answer: مَا رَأْيُكَ فِيمَا يَجِبُ أَنْ نَفْعَلَهُ أَوَّلًا؟

questions.text: Which format correctly introduces a speaker's line in written Arabic dialogue?
options: A quoted line with no attribution at all

questions.text: Which response naturally continues a dialogue after being asked "Are you free tomorrow?"
options: نَعَمْ، أَنَا حُرٌّ غَدًا، مَاذَا تَقْتَرِحُ؟
questions.answer: نَعَمْ، أَنَا حُرٌّ غَدًا، مَاذَا تَقْتَرِحُ؟

questions.text: What makes written dialogue feel natural and realistic?
options: Short, responsive exchanges that build logically on what the other person just said
Each speaker gives an unrelated long speech ignoring the other
Both speakers always agree instantly with no exchange of ideas
questions.answer: Short, responsive exchanges that build logically on what the other person just said

stages.title: At-Ta'bīr 'an al-Mustaqbal — Future Plans & Goals
stages.description: Expressing intentions, hopes, and step-by-step future plans

questions.text: Which sentence expresses a future goal: "I intend to become a doctor in the future"?
options: أَنْوِي أَنْ أُصْبِحَ طَبِيبًا فِي الْمُسْتَقْبَلِ
questions.answer: أَنْوِي أَنْ أُصْبِحَ طَبِيبًا فِي الْمُسْتَقْبَلِ

questions.text: Which phrase expresses hope for the future, "I hope that..."?
Which sentence outlines concrete steps toward a goal: "First, I will finish my studies, then I will look for a job"?
options: أَوَّلًا، سَأُنْهِي دِرَاسَتِي، ثُمَّ سَأَبْحَثُ عَنْ وَظِيفَةٍ
أَوَّلًا، سَأَبْحَثُ عَنْ وَظِيفَةٍ، ثُمَّ سَأَبْدَأُ دِرَاسَتِي
questions.answer: أَوَّلًا، سَأُنْهِي دِرَاسَتِي، ثُمَّ سَأَبْحَثُ عَنْ وَظِيفَةٍ

questions.text: Which phrase expresses determination toward a future goal, "I am determined to..."?
Which sentence expresses a long-term aspiration: "Within five years, I hope to have opened my own business"?
options: خِلَالَ خَمْسِ سَنَوَاتٍ، أَتَمَنَّى أَنْ أَكُونَ قَدْ فَتَحْتُ مَشْرُوعِي الْخَاصَّ
قَبْلَ خَمْسِ سَنَوَاتٍ، فَتَحْتُ مَشْرُوعِي الْخَاصَّ
questions.answer: خِلَالَ خَمْسِ سَنَوَاتٍ، أَتَمَنَّى أَنْ أَكُونَ قَدْ فَتَحْتُ مَشْرُوعِي الْخَاصَّ

stages.title: Al-Wasf bi'l-Ḥawāss — Descriptive Writing Using the Senses
stages.description: Enriching description with sight, sound, smell, and touch

questions.text: Which sentence uses smell to enrich a description: "The scent of fresh bread filled the small kitchen"?
options: مَلَأَتْ رَائِحَةُ الْخُبْزِ الطَّازَجِ الْمَطْبَخَ الصَّغِيرَ
questions.answer: مَلَأَتْ رَائِحَةُ الْخُبْزِ الطَّازَجِ الْمَطْبَخَ الصَّغِيرَ

questions.text: Which sentence uses sound to build atmosphere: "The waves crashed loudly against the rocks"?
options: الْبَحْرُ هَادِئٌ تَمَامًا وَلَا صَوْتَ لَهُ

questions.text: Which sentence uses touch/texture to deepen a description: "The old book's pages felt rough and dry beneath my fingers"?
options: شَعَرْتُ بِخُشُونَةِ وَجَفَافِ صَفَحَاتِ الْكِتَابِ الْقَدِيمِ تَحْتَ أَصَابِعِي
questions.answer: شَعَرْتُ بِخُشُونَةِ وَجَفَافِ صَفَحَاتِ الْكِتَابِ الْقَدِيمِ تَحْتَ أَصَابِعِي

questions.text: Why do skilled writers combine multiple senses in description?
options: It makes the scene feel more vivid and immersive for the reader
It avoids the need for any adjectives
It is required only in formal legal writing
questions.answer: It makes the scene feel more vivid and immersive for the reader

questions.text: Which sentence combines two senses (sight + sound) in one vivid description: "The colorful stalls buzzed with the shouts of vendors"?
options: كَانَتِ الْأَكْشَاكُ الْمُلَوَّنَةُ تَضِجُّ بِصِيَاحِ الْبَاعَةِ
questions.answer: كَانَتِ الْأَكْشَاكُ الْمُلَوَّنَةُ تَضِجُّ بِصِيَاحِ الْبَاعَةِ

stages.title: At-Talkhīṣ al-Basīṭ — Simple Summarizing
stages.description: Condensing a text's main ideas neutrally and briefly

questions.text: What is the main goal of a summary (تَلْخِيص)?
options: To restate the main ideas of a text briefly, in one's own words
To add new opinions not found in the original text
To make the text longer with more detail
questions.answer: To restate the main ideas of a text briefly, in one's own words

questions.text: Which phrase appropriately opens a summary, "The text discusses..."?
Which is a key skill when summarizing a long article about renewable energy?
options: Identifying and condensing only the central points, omitting minor details
Including every single detail and example from the article
Quoting the entire article word for word
Focusing only on one minor side detail while ignoring the main point
questions.answer: Identifying and condensing only the central points, omitting minor details

questions.text: Which is an appropriately concise summary sentence for an article about traffic congestion in cities?
options: يُنَاقِشُ النَّصُّ أَسْبَابَ ازْدِحَامِ الْمُرُورِ فِي الْمُدُنِ وَحُلُولَهُ الْمُمْكِنَةَ
يَذْكُرُ النَّصُّ فِي السَّطْرِ الثَّالِثِ اسْمَ شَارِعٍ مُعَيَّنٍ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ
questions.answer: يُنَاقِشُ النَّصُّ أَسْبَابَ ازْدِحَامِ الْمُرُورِ فِي الْمُدُنِ وَحُلُولَهُ الْمُمْكِنَةَ

questions.text: Why should a good summary avoid the summarizer's personal opinions?
options: Because a summary should neutrally reflect the original text's content, not the summarizer's views
Because opinions are illegal to write
Because summaries must always be negative
Because opinions make summaries too short
questions.answer: Because a summary should neutrally reflect the original text's content, not the summarizer's views

stages.title: Al-Iqnā' al-Awwalī — Basic Persuasive Expression
stages.description: Making a simple case and appealing to shared reasoning

questions.text: Which phrase directly appeals to the reader's reasoning, "Don't you think that...?"
Which sentence appeals to shared benefit: "This solution benefits all of us, not just some"?
options: هَذَا الْحَلُّ يُفِيدُنَا جَمِيعًا، وَلَيْسَ بَعْضَنَا فَقَط
هَذَا الْحَلُّ يُفِيدُ بَعْضَنَا وَيُؤْذِي الْبَاقِينَ
questions.answer: هَذَا الْحَلُّ يُفِيدُنَا جَمِيعًا، وَلَيْسَ بَعْضَنَا فَقَط

questions.text: Which persuasive technique uses a hypothetical scenario, e.g. "Imagine a city with no traffic at all"?
options: تَخَيَّلْ مَدِينَةً بِلَا ازْدِحَامٍ مُرُورِيٍّ عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
questions.answer: تَخَيَّلْ مَدِينَةً بِلَا ازْدِحَامٍ مُرُورِيٍّ عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ

questions.text: Which phrase strengthens a persuasive claim, "it is essential that..."?
Which basic persuasive paragraph structure is most effective?
options: Clear claim → supporting reasons → call to action
Random unrelated facts with no claim
Only questions with no claims or reasons
A claim followed immediately by an unrelated topic
questions.answer: Clear claim → supporting reasons → call to action

stages.title: Ar-Rasā'il ar-Rasmiyyah al-Basīṭah — Basic Formal Letters
stages.description: Register control: formal openings, requests, and closings

questions.text: Which opening phrase is appropriate for a basic formal letter/email, "Dear Sir/Madam"?
Which sentence appropriately opens the body of a formal complaint letter?
Which closing phrase is standard for a basic formal letter, "Sincerely / Yours faithfully"?
Which sentence correctly and formally requests information: "I would be grateful if you could provide further details"?
options: سَأَكُونُ مُمْتَنًّا لَوْ تَكَرَّمْتُمْ بِتَزْوِيدِي بِمَزِيدٍ مِنَ التَّفَاصِيلِ
questions.answer: سَأَكُونُ مُمْتَنًّا لَوْ تَكَرَّمْتُمْ بِتَزْوِيدِي بِمَزِيدٍ مِنَ التَّفَاصِيلِ

questions.text: What key difference distinguishes formal letter register from personal letter register?
options: Formal letters use respectful, impersonal titles and structured, polite phrasing rather than casual, affectionate language
Formal letters must always be handwritten
Formal letters never have a closing
Formal letters use slang to sound friendly
questions.answer: Formal letters use respectful, impersonal titles and structured, polite phrasing rather than casual, affectionate language

stages.title: At-Ta'bīr bi'sh-Sharṭ — Conditional Expression
stages.description: Real, hypothetical, and habitual conditional sentences

questions.text: Which conditional particle expresses "if" for a real/possible condition, e.g. "If you study, you will succeed"?
Which sentence correctly forms a real conditional: "If you study, you will succeed"?
Which particle is used for a hypothetical or contrary-to-fact condition, e.g. "If I were rich, I would travel the world"?
Which sentence correctly uses لَوْلَا to mean "were it not for...": "Were it not for your help, I would not have succeeded"?
Which conditional sentence expresses a general/habitual truth: "Whenever it rains, the streets get crowded with cars seeking shelter"?
options: كُلَّمَا أَمْطَرَتِ السَّمَاءُ، ازْدَحَمَتِ الشَّوَارِعُ بِالسَّيَّارَاتِ الْبَاحِثَةِ عَنْ مَأْوًى
كُلَّمَا أَمْطَرَتِ السَّمَاءُ، خَلَتِ الشَّوَارِعُ تَمَامًا مِنَ السَّيَّارَاتِ
الشَّوَارِعُ مُزْدَحِمَةٌ فِي الطَّقْسِ الْمُشْمِسِ فَقَط
questions.answer: كُلَّمَا أَمْطَرَتِ السَّمَاءُ، ازْدَحَمَتِ الشَّوَارِعُ بِالسَّيَّارَاتِ الْبَاحِثَةِ عَنْ مَأْوًى

stages.title: Kitābat Taqrīr Qaṣīr — Short Report Writing
stages.description: Objective, structured reporting of facts and findings

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of a short report (تَقْرِيرٌ قَصِيرٌ)؟
options: To objectively present findings, facts, or events on a specific topic in an organized way
To express purely personal feelings with no facts
To tell an imaginative fictional story
To write a casual message to a friend
questions.answer: To objectively present findings, facts, or events on a specific topic in an organized way

questions.text: Which opening line suits a short report on a school event, "This report presents an overview of..."?
options: يُقَدِّمُ هَذَا التَّقْرِيرُ لَمْحَةً عَامَّةً عَنْ...
كَانَ يَا مَا كَانَ فِي قَدِيمِ الزَّمَانِ...
questions.answer: يُقَدِّمُ هَذَا التَّقْرِيرُ لَمْحَةً عَامَّةً عَنْ...

questions.text: Which sentence best fits a report's objective, neutral tone?
options: كَانَ الْحَدَثُ رَائِعًا وَأَنَا أُحِبُّهُ كَثِيرًا جِدًّا!
أَشْعُرُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْحَدَثَ كَانَ أَفْضَلَ شَيْءٍ فِي حَيَاتِي
أَحْبَبْتُ كُلَّ لَحْظَةٍ فِي هَذَا الْحَدَثِ الْمُذْهِلِ

questions.text: Which structure is typical for a short report?
options: Introduction → main findings/body → recommendations or conclusion
Only a greeting and a farewell, no content
A single long unbroken paragraph of opinions
questions.answer: Introduction → main findings/body → recommendations or conclusion

questions.text: Which sentence appropriately closes a short report with a recommendation: "It is recommended that the event be held again next year"?
options: يُوصَى بِإِقَامَةِ الْحَدَثِ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى فِي الْعَامِ الْقَادِمِ
لَنْ يُقَامَ هَذَا الْحَدَثُ مُطْلَقًا مَرَّةً أُخْرَى
لَا أَعْرِفُ إِذَا كَانَ يَنْبَغِي إِقَامَتُهُ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى
الْحَدَثُ كَانَ سَيِّئًا وَلَا يَسْتَحِقُّ التَّكْرَارَ
questions.answer: يُوصَى بِإِقَامَةِ الْحَدَثِ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى فِي الْعَامِ الْقَادِمِ

stages.title: At-Tafḍīl wal-Muqāranah al-Mutaqaddimah — Advanced Comparison & Preference
stages.description: Qualified, nuanced comparisons and preferences

questions.text: Which sentence expresses a nuanced preference with a qualifying condition: "I prefer traveling by train, provided the journey isn't too long"?
options: أُفَضِّلُ السَّفَرَ بِالْقِطَارِ، بِشَرْطِ أَلَّا تَكُونَ الرِّحْلَةُ طَوِيلَةً جِدًّا
أُفَضِّلُ السَّفَرَ بِالْقِطَارِ بِلَا أَيِّ شُرُوطٍ عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
questions.answer: أُفَضِّلُ السَّفَرَ بِالْقِطَارِ، بِشَرْطِ أَلَّا تَكُونَ الرِّحْلَةُ طَوِيلَةً جِدًّا

questions.text: Which phrase weighs two options in a balanced, advanced way, "weighing the pros and cons of each"?
Which sentence expresses a comparison qualified by degree: "This option is only slightly better than that one"?
options: هَذَا الْخِيَارُ أَفْضَلُ قَلِيلًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَط
هَذَا الْخِيَارُ أَفْضَلُ بِكَثِيرٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ
questions.answer: هَذَا الْخِيَارُ أَفْضَلُ قَلِيلًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَط

questions.text: Which phrase introduces a comparison based on a specific criterion, "in terms of cost..."?
Which sentence makes an advanced, qualified superlative claim: "This is arguably one of the best solutions available, though not without drawbacks"?
options: يُمْكِنُ الْقَوْلُ إِنَّ هَذَا مِنْ أَفْضَلِ الْحُلُولِ الْمُتَاحَةِ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَخْلُ مِنَ الْعُيُوبِ
هَذَا هُوَ الْحَلُّ الْأَفْضَلُ الْوَحِيدُ بِلَا أَيِّ عُيُوبٍ
هَذَا الْحَلُّ سَيِّئٌ تَمَامًا وَلَا فَائِدَةَ مِنْهُ
لَا يُمْكِنُ الْمُقَارَنَةُ بَيْنَ الْحُلُولِ إِطْلَاقًا
questions.answer: يُمْكِنُ الْقَوْلُ إِنَّ هَذَا مِنْ أَفْضَلِ الْحُلُولِ الْمُتَاحَةِ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَخْلُ مِنَ الْعُيُوبِ

stages.title: Kitābat Qiṣṣah Qaṣīrah — Short Story Writing
stages.description: Setting scene, building tension, and resolving a narrative

questions.text: Which element is essential to a short story but generally absent from a factual report?
options: A narrative arc with characters, conflict, and resolution
questions.answer: A narrative arc with characters, conflict, and resolution

questions.text: Which opening line effectively sets a story's scene: "On a cold winter night, the old man walked alone through the empty streets"?
options: فِي لَيْلَةٍ شِتَائِيَّةٍ بَارِدَةٍ، مَشَى الرَّجُلُ الْعَجُوزُ وَحِيدًا فِي الشَّوَارِعِ الْخَالِيَةِ
الرَّجُلُ الْعَجُوزُ لَهُ عَنْوَانٌ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ
يُوجَدُ رَجُلٌ عَجُوزٌ فِي قَاعِدَةِ الْبَيَانَاتِ
questions.answer: فِي لَيْلَةٍ شِتَائِيَّةٍ بَارِدَةٍ، مَشَى الرَّجُلُ الْعَجُوزُ وَحِيدًا فِي الشَّوَارِعِ الْخَالِيَةِ

questions.text: Which sentence introduces narrative tension, essential to a short story: "Suddenly, he heard a strange noise behind him"?
options: كَانَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ هَادِئًا وَمُمِلًّا طَوَالَ الْقِصَّةِ بِلَا أَيِّ حَدَثٍ
لَمْ يَحْدُثْ شَيْءٌ فِي هَذِهِ اللَّحْظَةِ
اسْتَمَرَّ فِي الْمَشْيِ بِهُدُوءٍ تَامٍّ بِلَا تَغْيِيرٍ

questions.text: Which sentence provides narrative resolution: "In the end, he realized the noise was only the wind, and he smiled with relief"?
options: فِي النِّهَايَةِ، أَدْرَكَ أَنَّ الصَّوْتَ لَمْ يَكُنْ سِوَى الرِّيحِ، وَابْتَسَمَ بِارْتِيَاحٍ
فِي النِّهَايَةِ، لَمْ يَعْرِفْ أَبَدًا مَصْدَرَ الصَّوْتِ وَبَقِيَ خَائِفًا إِلَى الْأَبَدِ
لَمْ يَحْدُثْ شَيْءٌ فِي هَذِهِ الْقِصَّةِ مِنَ الْبِدَايَةِ
questions.answer: فِي النِّهَايَةِ، أَدْرَكَ أَنَّ الصَّوْتَ لَمْ يَكُنْ سِوَى الرِّيحِ، وَابْتَسَمَ بِارْتِيَاحٍ

questions.text: Why is varied, descriptive vocabulary especially important in short story writing?
options: It brings characters, settings, and events vividly to life for the reader
It is not important at all in stories
Stories should use only simple present-tense verbs
Descriptive vocabulary is only used in formal reports, not stories
questions.answer: It brings characters, settings, and events vividly to life for the reader

stages.title: Murāja'ah — Intermediate Capstone Review
stages.description: The capstone review: combining description, narration, reasoning, and register

questions.text: Which paragraph best combines description, cause-effect, and opinion about city pollution: "Our city is beautiful, but pollution has increased because of traffic; therefore, I believe stricter laws are needed"?
options: مَدِينَتُنَا جَمِيلَةٌ، لَكِنَّ التَّلَوُّثَ ازْدَادَ بِسَبَبِ حَرَكَةِ الْمُرُورِ، لِذَلِكَ أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّنَا بِحَاجَةٍ إِلَى قَوَانِينَ أَكْثَرَ صَرَامَةً
مَدِينَتُنَا جَمِيلَةٌ وَلَا تَلَوُّثَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
لَا أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّنَا بِحَاجَةٍ إِلَى أَيِّ قَوَانِينَ
questions.answer: مَدِينَتُنَا جَمِيلَةٌ، لَكِنَّ التَّلَوُّثَ ازْدَادَ بِسَبَبِ حَرَكَةِ الْمُرُورِ، لِذَلِكَ أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّنَا بِحَاجَةٍ إِلَى قَوَانِينَ أَكْثَرَ صَرَامَةً

questions.text: Which sentence best opens a short story using vivid sensory detail: "The smell of the sea filled the air as the old fisherman walked slowly along the shore"?
options: مَلَأَتْ رَائِحَةُ الْبَحْرِ الْهَوَاءَ بَيْنَمَا كَانَ الصَّيَّادُ الْعَجُوزُ يَمْشِي بِبُطْءٍ عَلَى طُولِ الشَّاطِئِ
الصَّيَّادُ يَعْمَلُ فِي مَكْتَبٍ بَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْبَحْرِ
questions.answer: مَلَأَتْ رَائِحَةُ الْبَحْرِ الْهَوَاءَ بَيْنَمَا كَانَ الصَّيَّادُ الْعَجُوزُ يَمْشِي بِبُطْءٍ عَلَى طُولِ الشَّاطِئِ

questions.text: Which formal letter opening + request combination matches register: "Dear Sir, I would be grateful if you could send the report by Monday"?
options: السَّيِّدُ الْمُحْتَرَمُ، سَأَكُونُ مُمْتَنًّا لَوْ تَكَرَّمْتُمْ بِإِرْسَالِ التَّقْرِيرِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ
يَا حَبِيبِي، أَرْسِلْ لِي التَّقْرِيرَ حَالًا!
السَّيِّدُ الْمُحْتَرَمُ، لَا أُرِيدُ أَيَّ تَقْرِيرٍ
questions.answer: السَّيِّدُ الْمُحْتَرَمُ، سَأَكُونُ مُمْتَنًّا لَوْ تَكَرَّمْتُمْ بِإِرْسَالِ التَّقْرِيرِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ

questions.text: Which conditional + persuasive combination is most effective in an argumentative closing: "If we act now, we can still protect our environment for future generations"?
options: إِذَا تَحَرَّكْنَا الْآنَ، فَمَا زَالَ بِإِمْكَانِنَا حِمَايَةُ بِيئَتِنَا لِلْأَجْيَالِ الْقَادِمَةِ
إِذَا تَحَرَّكْنَا الْآنَ، فَلَنْ نَسْتَطِيعَ حِمَايَةَ شَيْءٍ عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
لَنْ نَتَحَرَّكَ أَبَدًا وَلَا دَاعِيَ لِذَلِكَ
بِيئَتُنَا لَيْسَتْ بِحَاجَةٍ إِلَى أَيِّ حِمَايَةٍ
questions.answer: إِذَا تَحَرَّكْنَا الْآنَ، فَمَا زَالَ بِإِمْكَانِنَا حِمَايَةُ بِيئَتِنَا لِلْأَجْيَالِ الْقَادِمَةِ

questions.text: Which is the best one-sentence summary of a long article about the benefits and risks of social media?
options: يَسْتَعْرِضُ النَّصُّ فَوَائِدَ وَسَائِلِ التَّوَاصُلِ الِاجْتِمَاعِيِّ وَمَخَاطِرَهَا الْمُحْتَمَلَةَ
يَتَحَدَّثُ النَّصُّ عَنْ نَوْعٍ مُعَيَّنٍ مِنَ الْقَهْوَةِ
لَا يُوجَدُ أَيُّ مَحْتَوَى فِي هَذَا النَّصِّ
النَّصُّ يَتَحَدَّثُ فَقَط عَنِ اسْمِ الْكَاتِبِ
questions.answer: يَسْتَعْرِضُ النَّصُّ فَوَائِدَ وَسَائِلِ التَّوَاصُلِ الِاجْتِمَاعِيِّ وَمَخَاطِرَهَا الْمُحْتَمَلَةَ

questions.text: Across the Intermediate level, what is the overarching skill progression compared to Beginner?
options: Moving from single simple sentences to structured, multi-sentence paragraphs that combine description, narration, reasoning, and register control
Simply repeating the same beginner-level sentences with new vocabulary
Focusing exclusively on memorizing grammar rules with no composition practice
Abandoning connectors and writing only isolated single words
questions.answer: Moving from single simple sentences to structured, multi-sentence paragraphs that combine description, narration, reasoning, and register control

difficulties.label: Advanced
difficulties.description: Full argumentative essays, advanced discourse connectors, critical analysis, and formal speech

stages.title: Al-Muqaddimah al-Iqnā'iyyah — The Persuasive Introduction
stages.description: Opening an argumentative piece with a clear thesis statement

questions.text: Which sentence best functions as a clear thesis statement opening an essay on renewable energy: "This essay argues that renewable energy is the only sustainable path forward"?
options: تَزْعُمُ هَذِهِ الْمَقَالَةُ أَنَّ الطَّاقَةَ الْمُتَجَدِّدَةَ هِيَ السَّبِيلُ الْمُسْتَدَامُ الْوَحِيدُ
لَا أَعْرِفُ شَيْئًا عَنِ الطَّاقَةِ عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
رُبَّمَا تَكُونُ الطَّاقَةُ مُهِمَّةً أَوْ لَا
questions.answer: تَزْعُمُ هَذِهِ الْمَقَالَةُ أَنَّ الطَّاقَةَ الْمُتَجَدِّدَةَ هِيَ السَّبِيلُ الْمُسْتَدَامُ الْوَحِيدُ

questions.text: Which phrase signals to the reader that a formal argumentative position is about to be stated, "This paper contends that..."?
A strong thesis statement should be:
options: Specific, arguable, and stated with confidence
Vague and open to no interpretation
A simple factual observation with no claim
A question rather than a statement
questions.answer: Specific, arguable, and stated with confidence

questions.text: Which sentence previews the essay's structure, "In what follows, I will first examine the causes, then the effects, before proposing solutions"?
options: فِيمَا يَلِي، سَأَتَنَاوَلُ أَوَّلًا الْأَسْبَابَ، ثُمَّ الْآثَارَ، قَبْلَ اقْتِرَاحِ الْحُلُولِ
لَا أَعْرِفُ مَاذَا سَأَكْتُبُ فِيمَا يَلِي
سَأَتَحَدَّثُ عَنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ يَخْطُرُ بِبَالِي
questions.answer: فِيمَا يَلِي، سَأَتَنَاوَلُ أَوَّلًا الْأَسْبَابَ، ثُمَّ الْآثَارَ، قَبْلَ اقْتِرَاحِ الْحُلُولِ

questions.text: Which opening best establishes the stakes/importance of the topic before the thesis: "Few issues today are as urgent as the future of our climate"?
options: قَلِيلَةٌ هِيَ الْقَضَايَا الْيَوْمَ الَّتِي تَبْلُغُ إِلْحَاحَ مُسْتَقْبَلِ مُنَاخِنَا
الْمُنَاخُ مَوْضُوعٌ لَا أَهَمِّيَّةَ لَهُ إِطْلَاقًا
لَا يُوجَدُ أَيُّ قَضَايَا مُهِمَّةٍ فِي عَصْرِنَا
سَأَتَحَدَّثُ عَنِ الطَّقْسِ فَقَط دُونَ أَيِّ سِيَاقٍ
questions.answer: قَلِيلَةٌ هِيَ الْقَضَايَا الْيَوْمَ الَّتِي تَبْلُغُ إِلْحَاحَ مُسْتَقْبَلِ مُنَاخِنَا

stages.title: Binā' al-Ḥujjah — Building an Argument
stages.description: Structuring a claim with supporting evidence and reasoning

questions.text: Which sentence correctly links a claim to its supporting evidence: "Studies show that reading daily improves vocabulary, which supports my claim that schools should encourage it"?
options: تُظْهِرُ الدِّرَاسَاتُ أَنَّ الْقِرَاءَةَ الْيَوْمِيَّةَ تُحَسِّنُ الْمُفْرَدَاتِ، مِمَّا يَدْعَمُ رَأْيِي بِأَنَّ عَلَى الْمَدَارِسِ تَشْجِيعَهَا
الْقِرَاءَةُ شَيْءٌ يَفْعَلُهُ بَعْضُ النَّاسِ أَحْيَانًا
لَا تُوجَدُ أَيُّ عَلَاقَةٍ بَيْنَ الْقِرَاءَةِ وَالْمُفْرَدَاتِ
الْمَدَارِسُ لَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ تَهْتَمَّ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ
questions.answer: تُظْهِرُ الدِّرَاسَاتُ أَنَّ الْقِرَاءَةَ الْيَوْمِيَّةَ تُحَسِّنُ الْمُفْرَدَاتِ، مِمَّا يَدْعَمُ رَأْيِي بِأَنَّ عَلَى الْمَدَارِسِ تَشْجِيعَهَا

questions.text: Which phrase introduces evidence formally, meaning "as evidenced by..."?
In a well-built argument, the 'warrant' is best described as:
options: The reasoning that explains why the evidence supports the claim
A random fact unrelated to the claim
questions.answer: The reasoning that explains why the evidence supports the claim

questions.text: Which sentence uses a logical connector to move from evidence to conclusion, "Given this evidence, it follows that..."?
options: بِنَاءً عَلَى هَذَا الدَّلِيلِ، يَتَرَتَّبُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ أَنَّ...
بِالرَّغْمِ مِنْ هَذَا الدَّلِيلِ، فَلَا شَيْءَ يَتَرَتَّبُ
هَذَا الدَّلِيلُ لَا عَلَاقَةَ لَهُ بِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ
questions.answer: بِنَاءً عَلَى هَذَا الدَّلِيلِ، يَتَرَتَّبُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ أَنَّ...

questions.text: Which sentence strengthens an argument by citing a statistic: "According to recent statistics, 70% of students prefer online resources"?
options: وَفْقًا لِإِحْصَائِيَّاتٍ حَدِيثَةٍ، يُفَضِّلُ سَبْعُونَ بِالْمِائَةِ مِنَ الطُّلَّابِ الْمَصَادِرَ الْإِلِكْتْرُونِيَّةَ
رُبَّمَا يُفَضِّلُ بَعْضُ الطُّلَّابِ شَيْئًا مَا
لَا تُوجَدُ إِحْصَائِيَّاتٌ عَنْ هَذَا الْمَوْضُوعِ إِطْلَاقًا
questions.answer: وَفْقًا لِإِحْصَائِيَّاتٍ حَدِيثَةٍ، يُفَضِّلُ سَبْعُونَ بِالْمِائَةِ مِنَ الطُّلَّابِ الْمَصَادِرَ الْإِلِكْتْرُونِيَّةَ

stages.title: Adawāt ar-Rabṭ al-Mutaqaddimah — Advanced Discourse Connectors
stages.description: Sophisticated connectors for concession, emphasis, and nuance

questions.text: Which connector introduces a concession before a stronger counterpoint, "Even though / despite the fact that"?
Which connector expresses emphatic addition, "not only... but also"?
Which connector introduces a logical consequence in formal writing, "consequently / as a result"?
Which connector is used to introduce a clarifying example in formal register, "to illustrate / for instance"?
Which sentence correctly uses a contrastive connector meaning "whereas / while" to compare two ideas: "While some prefer the city, others prefer the countryside"?
options: فِي حِينِ أَنَّ بَعْضَهُمْ يُفَضِّلُ الْمَدِينَةَ، يُفَضِّلُ آخَرُونَ الرِّيفَ
الْمَدِينَةُ وَالرِّيفُ مُتَشَابِهَانِ تَمَامًا بِلَا فَرْقٍ
questions.answer: فِي حِينِ أَنَّ بَعْضَهُمْ يُفَضِّلُ الْمَدِينَةَ، يُفَضِّلُ آخَرُونَ الرِّيفَ

stages.title: Ar-Radd 'alā al-Ḥujaj al-Muḍāddah — Rebuttal & Counter-Argument
stages.description: Acknowledging and refuting opposing viewpoints

questions.text: Which sentence correctly acknowledges an opposing view before refuting it: "Some may argue that this policy is costly; however, the long-term savings outweigh the initial expense"?
options: قَدْ يَزْعُمُ الْبَعْضُ أَنَّ هَذِهِ السِّيَاسَةَ مُكْلِفَةٌ؛ غَيْرَ أَنَّ الْوَفْرَ عَلَى الْمَدَى الْبَعِيدِ يَفُوقُ التَّكْلِفَةَ الْأَوَّلِيَّةَ
هَذِهِ السِّيَاسَةُ مُكْلِفَةٌ وَلَا فَائِدَةَ مِنْهَا أَبَدًا
لَا أَحَدَ يَعْتَرِضُ عَلَى هَذِهِ السِّيَاسَةِ
questions.answer: قَدْ يَزْعُمُ الْبَعْضُ أَنَّ هَذِهِ السِّيَاسَةَ مُكْلِفَةٌ؛ غَيْرَ أَنَّ الْوَفْرَ عَلَى الْمَدَى الْبَعِيدِ يَفُوقُ التَّكْلِفَةَ الْأَوَّلِيَّةَ

questions.text: Which phrase formally introduces a counter-argument, "critics of this view argue that..."?
options: يُحِبُّ الْجَمِيعُ هَذَا الرَّأْيَ بِلَا اسْتِثْنَاءٍ
لَا يُوجَدُ أَيُّ نَقْدٍ لِهَذَا الرَّأْيِ

questions.text: A strong rebuttal typically does which of the following?
options: Fairly states the opposing view, then explains its weakness with reasoning or evidence
Insults those who hold the opposing view
Simply repeats the original claim louder
questions.answer: Fairly states the opposing view, then explains its weakness with reasoning or evidence

questions.text: Which sentence uses a concessive-then-rebuttal structure meaning "While it is true that X, it does not follow that Y"?
options: وَإِنْ كَانَ صَحِيحًا أَنَّ كَذَا، فَلَا يَعْنِي ذَلِكَ أَنَّ كَذَا
بِمَا أَنَّ كَذَا صَحِيحٌ، فَإِنَّ كَذَا صَحِيحٌ أَيْضًا حَتْمًا
questions.answer: وَإِنْ كَانَ صَحِيحًا أَنَّ كَذَا، فَلَا يَعْنِي ذَلِكَ أَنَّ كَذَا

questions.text: Which phrase signals refutation of a claim's underlying assumption, "this argument overlooks the fact that..."?
options: لَا أَعْتَرِضُ عَلَى هَذَا الِاسْتِدْلَالِ إِطْلَاقًا
هَذَا الِاسْتِدْلَالُ مَقْبُولٌ تَمَامًا بِلَا نِقَاشٍ

stages.title: Al-Khiṭābah — Formal Speech & Oratory
stages.description: Crafting and delivering a formal spoken address

questions.text: Which opening is appropriate for a formal speech addressing an audience, "Distinguished guests, ladies and gentlemen"?
Which rhetorical device is commonly used in oratory to emphasize a point through repetition of a phrase across successive sentences?
options: Anaphora (repeating an opening phrase for emphasis)
questions.answer: Anaphora (repeating an opening phrase for emphasis)

questions.text: Which closing line effectively ends a formal speech with a call to action: "Let us, together, build a brighter future"?
Which sentence uses a rhetorical question effectively within a speech, "Is it not our duty to protect the coming generations?"?
options: أَلَيْسَ مِنْ وَاجِبِنَا أَنْ نَحْمِيَ الْأَجْيَالَ الْقَادِمَةَ؟
questions.answer: أَلَيْسَ مِنْ وَاجِبِنَا أَنْ نَحْمِيَ الْأَجْيَالَ الْقَادِمَةَ؟

questions.text: In formal oratory, tone and pacing should generally be:
options: Measured and deliberate, with emphasis placed on key phrases
Silent for most of the speech
questions.answer: Measured and deliberate, with emphasis placed on key phrases

stages.title: Al-Muqālah al-Ḥijājiyyah — The Argumentative Essay
stages.description: Structuring a complete essay: introduction, body, rebuttal, conclusion

questions.text: What is the correct overall structure of a well-formed argumentative essay?
options: Introduction with thesis → body paragraphs with evidence → rebuttal of counter-arguments → conclusion
A single long paragraph with no divisions
Conclusion first, then evidence, then no introduction
Random order of ideas with no thesis
questions.answer: Introduction with thesis → body paragraphs with evidence → rebuttal of counter-arguments → conclusion

questions.text: Which topic sentence best opens a body paragraph supporting a thesis about screen time: "First, excessive screen time has been linked to reduced attention spans in children"?
options: أَوَّلًا، ارْتَبَطَ الْإِفْرَاطُ فِي وَقْتِ الشَّاشَةِ بِانْخِفَاضِ فَتْرَةِ الِانْتِبَاهِ لَدَى الْأَطْفَالِ
لَا عَلَاقَةَ بَيْنَ الشَّاشَاتِ وَالِانْتِبَاهِ إِطْلَاقًا
questions.answer: أَوَّلًا، ارْتَبَطَ الْإِفْرَاطُ فِي وَقْتِ الشَّاشَةِ بِانْخِفَاضِ فَتْرَةِ الِانْتِبَاهِ لَدَى الْأَطْفَالِ

questions.text: Which sentence transitions from one body paragraph to the next while maintaining logical flow, "In addition to the above, another key factor is..."?
options: إِضَافَةً إِلَى مَا سَبَقَ، هُنَاكَ عَامِلٌ رَئِيسِيٌّ آخَرُ هُوَ...
بِخِلَافِ مَا سَبَقَ تَمَامًا وَلَا عَلَاقَةَ لَهُ بِهِ
لَا شَيْءَ آخَرَ يُذْكَرُ بَعْدَ هَذَا
أَنْهِي كِتَابَتِي هُنَا بِلَا أَيِّ إِضَافَةٍ
questions.answer: إِضَافَةً إِلَى مَا سَبَقَ، هُنَاكَ عَامِلٌ رَئِيسِيٌّ آخَرُ هُوَ...

questions.text: Which sentence forms an effective, non-repetitive conclusion that reinforces the thesis without merely restating it word-for-word: "Ultimately, the evidence presented makes clear that reform is not optional but necessary"?
options: فِي نِهَايَةِ الْمَطَافِ، تُوَضِّحُ الْأَدِلَّةُ الْمَعْرُوضَةُ أَنَّ الْإِصْلَاحَ لَيْسَ خِيَارًا بَلْ ضَرُورَةً
كَمَا قُلْتُ فِي الْبِدَايَةِ بِالضَّبْطِ وَبِنَفْسِ الْكَلِمَاتِ
لَا أَدْرِي إِنْ كَانَ الْإِصْلَاحُ مُهِمًّا
الْإِصْلَاحُ مَوْضُوعٌ لَا يَسْتَحِقُّ الْكِتَابَةَ عَنْهُ
questions.answer: فِي نِهَايَةِ الْمَطَافِ، تُوَضِّحُ الْأَدِلَّةُ الْمَعْرُوضَةُ أَنَّ الْإِصْلَاحَ لَيْسَ خِيَارًا بَلْ ضَرُورَةً

questions.text: Why should an argumentative essay address counter-arguments rather than ignore them?
options: Addressing them strengthens credibility by showing the writer has considered other perspectives fairly
It is required only in casual writing, never formal essays
Counter-arguments should always be hidden from the reader
It makes the essay shorter and less convincing
questions.answer: Addressing them strengthens credibility by showing the writer has considered other perspectives fairly

stages.title: At-Taḥlīl an-Naqdī — Critical Analysis
stages.description: Analyzing a text's argument, evidence, and effectiveness

questions.text: Which sentence critically evaluates an author's evidence rather than just summarizing it: "While the author cites relevant statistics, the sample size raises questions about reliability"?
options: وَإِنِ اسْتَشْهَدَ الْكَاتِبُ بِإِحْصَائِيَّاتٍ ذَاتِ صِلَةٍ، فَإِنَّ حَجْمَ الْعَيِّنَةِ يُثِيرُ تَسَاؤُلَاتٍ حَوْلَ الْمِصْدَاقِيَّةِ
لَا أَهَمِّيَّةَ لِلْإِحْصَائِيَّاتِ فِي أَيِّ نَصٍّ
الْمِصْدَاقِيَّةُ لَا عَلَاقَةَ لَهَا بِحَجْمِ الْعَيِّنَةِ
questions.answer: وَإِنِ اسْتَشْهَدَ الْكَاتِبُ بِإِحْصَائِيَّاتٍ ذَاتِ صِلَةٍ، فَإِنَّ حَجْمَ الْعَيِّنَةِ يُثِيرُ تَسَاؤُلَاتٍ حَوْلَ الْمِصْدَاقِيَّةِ

questions.text: Which phrase introduces an evaluation of an argument's logical weakness, "this reasoning is flawed because..."?
options: هَذَا الِاسْتِدْلَالُ مُتِينٌ جِدًّا بِلَا أَيِّ عَيْبٍ
لَا يُمْكِنُ تَقْيِيمُ أَيِّ اسْتِدْلَالٍ أَبَدًا

questions.text: Critical analysis of a text differs from a summary chiefly because it:
options: Evaluates the strength, bias, and effectiveness of the argument rather than just restating it
Only restates the author's points in the same order
Focuses solely on spelling and grammar errors
questions.answer: Evaluates the strength, bias, and effectiveness of the argument rather than just restating it

questions.text: Which sentence identifies a potential bias in a source: "Given that the report was funded by the industry itself, its conclusions should be read with caution"?
options: بِمَا أَنَّ التَّقْرِيرَ مُوَّلٌ مِنَ الصِّنَاعَةِ نَفْسِهَا، فَيَنْبَغِي قِرَاءَةُ اسْتِنْتَاجَاتِهِ بِحَذَرٍ
التَّقْرِيرُ مُمَوَّلٌ فَلَا بُدَّ أَنَّهُ صَحِيحٌ تَمَامًا
مَصْدَرُ التَّمْوِيلِ لَا يُؤَثِّرُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ أَبَدًا
لَا يَنْبَغِي قِرَاءَةُ أَيِّ تَقْرِيرٍ عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
questions.answer: بِمَا أَنَّ التَّقْرِيرَ مُوَّلٌ مِنَ الصِّنَاعَةِ نَفْسِهَا، فَيَنْبَغِي قِرَاءَةُ اسْتِنْتَاجَاتِهِ بِحَذَرٍ

questions.text: Which phrase acknowledges a text's strength before noting a limitation, "the argument is compelling, yet it fails to address..."?
options: الِاسْتِدْلَالُ مُقْنِعٌ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَا يُعَالِجُ...
لَا يُوجَدُ أَيُّ اسْتِدْلَالٍ فِي هَذَا النَّصِّ
الِاسْتِدْلَالُ يُعَالِجُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ بِلَا اسْتِثْنَاءٍ
questions.answer: الِاسْتِدْلَالُ مُقْنِعٌ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَا يُعَالِجُ...

stages.title: Al-Uslūb al-Akādīmī — Academic Register & Tone
stages.description: Formal, objective, precise academic writing conventions

questions.text: Which sentence uses appropriate academic hedging rather than an overconfident claim, "The findings suggest, though do not conclusively prove, a correlation"?
options: تُشِيرُ النَّتَائِجُ، دُونَ أَنْ تُثْبِتَ ذَلِكَ بِشَكْلٍ قَاطِعٍ، إِلَى وُجُودِ ارْتِبَاطٍ
النَّتَائِجُ تُثْبِتُ هَذَا الِارْتِبَاطَ بِشَكْلٍ قَاطِعٍ لَا شَكَّ فِيهِ
لَا تُوجَدُ أَيَّةُ نَتَائِجَ فِي هَذِهِ الدِّرَاسَةِ
questions.answer: تُشِيرُ النَّتَائِجُ، دُونَ أَنْ تُثْبِتَ ذَلِكَ بِشَكْلٍ قَاطِعٍ، إِلَى وُجُودِ ارْتِبَاطٍ

questions.text: Which of the following is characteristic of academic register in Arabic writing?
options: Avoiding colloquial expressions and using precise, impersonal, formal vocabulary
Using slang and regional dialect freely
Writing in the first-person casual style used in text messages
Frequent use of exclamation marks for emphasis
questions.answer: Avoiding colloquial expressions and using precise, impersonal, formal vocabulary

questions.text: Which phrase is an appropriately impersonal academic construction, "it can be observed that..." (rather than "I saw that...")?
Which sentence correctly cites a source in formal academic style, "As Ibn Khaldūn notes in his Muqaddimah..."?
options: كَمَا يُشِيرُ ابْنُ خَلْدُونٍ فِي مُقَدِّمَتِهِ...
رُبَّمَا قَالَ أَحَدٌ شَيْئًا مَا يَوْمًا مَا...
questions.answer: كَمَا يُشِيرُ ابْنُ خَلْدُونٍ فِي مُقَدِّمَتِهِ...

questions.text: Why is precision of vocabulary especially valued in academic Arabic writing?
options: It reduces ambiguity and ensures the reader interprets claims exactly as intended
It makes the text sound more mysterious and hard to understand
It is not valued; vague language is preferred
It replaces the need for evidence entirely
questions.answer: It reduces ambiguity and ensures the reader interprets claims exactly as intended

stages.title: At-Talkhīṣ al-Mutaqaddim — Advanced Summarizing & Synthesis
stages.description: Condensing and synthesizing multiple sources into one coherent account

questions.text: Which sentence best synthesizes two differing sources into one coherent statement: "While one study emphasizes economic benefits, another highlights environmental costs, together painting a more complete picture"?
options: فِي حِينِ تُبْرِزُ إِحْدَى الدِّرَاسَتَيْنِ الْفَوَائِدَ الِاقْتِصَادِيَّةَ، تُسَلِّطُ الْأُخْرَى الضَّوْءَ عَلَى التَّكَالِيفِ الْبِيئِيَّةِ، لِتُشَكِّلَا مَعًا صُورَةً أَكْمَلَ
الدِّرَاسَتَانِ مُتَطَابِقَتَانِ تَمَامًا بِلَا أَيِّ فَرْقٍ
لَا فَائِدَةَ مِنْ قِرَاءَةِ دِرَاسَتَيْنِ مُخْتَلِفَتَيْنِ
إِحْدَى الدِّرَاسَتَيْنِ خَاطِئَةٌ تَمَامًا بِلَا شَكٍّ
questions.answer: فِي حِينِ تُبْرِزُ إِحْدَى الدِّرَاسَتَيْنِ الْفَوَائِدَ الِاقْتِصَادِيَّةَ، تُسَلِّطُ الْأُخْرَى الضَّوْءَ عَلَى التَّكَالِيفِ الْبِيئِيَّةِ، لِتُشَكِّلَا مَعًا صُورَةً أَكْمَلَ

questions.text: What distinguishes synthesis from simple summarizing?
options: Synthesis combines ideas from multiple sources into a new, integrated understanding
Synthesis only repeats one source's ideas word for word
Synthesis ignores all sources and states personal opinion only
Synthesis is identical to summarizing, just longer
questions.answer: Synthesis combines ideas from multiple sources into a new, integrated understanding

questions.text: Which phrase signals a shift to compare two sources' differing conclusions, "by contrast, the second source concludes that..."?
options: فِي الْمُقَابِلِ، يَخْلُصُ الْمَصْدَرُ الثَّانِي إِلَى أَنَّ...
وَبِنَفْسِ الطَّرِيقَةِ تَمَامًا دُونَ أَيِّ اخْتِلَافٍ
الْمَصْدَرُ الثَّانِي لَا يَذْكُرُ أَيَّ اسْتِنْتَاجٍ
لَا عَلَاقَةَ بَيْنَ الْمَصْدَرَيْنِ عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
questions.answer: فِي الْمُقَابِلِ، يَخْلُصُ الْمَصْدَرُ الثَّانِي إِلَى أَنَّ...

questions.text: Which one-sentence synthesis best captures the shared conclusion of several sources on urban housing, without listing each source separately?
options: تَتَّفِقُ الْمَصَادِرُ عُمُومًا عَلَى أَنَّ أَزْمَةَ الْإِسْكَانِ الْحَضَرِيِّ تَتَطَلَّبُ حُلُولًا سِيَاسِيَّةً وَاقْتِصَادِيَّةً مُشْتَرَكَةً
كُلُّ مَصْدَرٍ يَقُولُ شَيْئًا مُخْتَلِفًا تَمَامًا عَنِ الْآخَرِ بِلَا أَيِّ رَابِطٍ
الْإِسْكَانُ الْحَضَرِيُّ لَيْسَ مَوْضُوعًا يَسْتَحِقُّ الدِّرَاسَةَ
لَا تُوجَدُ أَيَّةُ مَصَادِرَ تَتَحَدَّثُ عَنْ هَذَا الْمَوْضُوعِ
questions.answer: تَتَّفِقُ الْمَصَادِرُ عُمُومًا عَلَى أَنَّ أَزْمَةَ الْإِسْكَانِ الْحَضَرِيِّ تَتَطَلَّبُ حُلُولًا سِيَاسِيَّةً وَاقْتِصَادِيَّةً مُشْتَرَكَةً

questions.text: When synthesizing sources, a writer should primarily avoid:
options: Simply stacking separate summaries without showing how the sources relate to each other
Mentioning more than one source in the same paragraph
questions.answer: Simply stacking separate summaries without showing how the sources relate to each other

stages.title: Al-Muqāranah bayn Wijhatay Naẓar — Comparing Two Viewpoints
stages.description: Presenting and weighing two contrasting perspectives fairly

questions.text: Which sentence fairly presents both sides of a debate before offering a personal position: "Proponents cite economic growth, while opponents warn of inequality; on balance, I find the latter concern more pressing"?
options: يَسْتَشْهِدُ الْمُؤَيِّدُونَ بِالنُّمُوِّ الِاقْتِصَادِيِّ، بَيْنَمَا يُحَذِّرُ الْمُعَارِضُونَ مِنَ التَّفَاوُتِ؛ وَفِي التَّوَازُنِ، أَجِدُ الْمِخَاوَفَ الْأَخِيرَةَ أَكْثَرَ إِلْحَاحًا
الْمُؤَيِّدُونَ عَلَى حَقٍّ تَمَامًا وَالْمُعَارِضُونَ مُخْطِئُونَ دَائِمًا
لَا يُوجَدُ أَيُّ خِلَافٍ حَوْلَ هَذَا الْمَوْضُوعِ
لَا رَأْيَ لِي عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ فِي أَيِّ شَيْءٍ
questions.answer: يَسْتَشْهِدُ الْمُؤَيِّدُونَ بِالنُّمُوِّ الِاقْتِصَادِيِّ، بَيْنَمَا يُحَذِّرُ الْمُعَارِضُونَ مِنَ التَّفَاوُتِ؛ وَفِي التَّوَازُنِ، أَجِدُ الْمِخَاوَفَ الْأَخِيرَةَ أَكْثَرَ إِلْحَاحًا

questions.text: Which phrase introduces the first of two viewpoints in a balanced comparison, "on the one hand..."?
Which phrase introduces the second, contrasting viewpoint, "on the other hand..."?
A fair comparison of two viewpoints should:
options: Represent each side accurately before evaluating them, avoiding straw-man distortion
Deliberately misrepresent the weaker side to make it easier to dismiss
Only present one side and ignore the other
Avoid ever stating a personal conclusion, even when asked
questions.answer: Represent each side accurately before evaluating them, avoiding straw-man distortion

questions.text: Which sentence weighs two viewpoints and reaches a qualified conclusion: "Although both arguments have merit, the evidence tilts slightly in favor of the first"?
options: عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ أَنَّ لِكِلَا الرَّأْيَيْنِ وَجَاهَةً، فَإِنَّ الْأَدِلَّةَ تَمِيلُ قَلِيلًا لِصَالِحِ الْأَوَّلِ
الرَّأْيُ الْأَوَّلُ صَحِيحٌ مِائَةً بِالْمِائَةِ وَالثَّانِي خَاطِئٌ تَمَامًا
لَا يُمْكِنُ تَقْيِيمُ أَيِّ رَأْيٍ عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
questions.answer: عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ أَنَّ لِكِلَا الرَّأْيَيْنِ وَجَاهَةً، فَإِنَّ الْأَدِلَّةَ تَمِيلُ قَلِيلًا لِصَالِحِ الْأَوَّلِ

stages.title: Kitābat al-Muqtaraḥ — Proposal Writing
stages.description: Proposing a solution or project with justification and plan

questions.text: Which sentence correctly opens a proposal by identifying a problem, "This proposal addresses the growing issue of traffic congestion downtown"?
options: يَتَنَاوَلُ هَذَا الِاقْتِرَاحُ مُشْكِلَةَ ازْدِحَامِ الْمُرُورِ الْمُتَزَايِدَةَ فِي وَسَطِ الْمَدِينَةِ
لَا تُوجَدُ أَيَّةُ مُشْكِلَةٍ فِي وَسَطِ الْمَدِينَةِ
هَذَا الِاقْتِرَاحُ لَا يَتَنَاوَلُ أَيَّ شَيْءٍ مُحَدَّدٍ
questions.answer: يَتَنَاوَلُ هَذَا الِاقْتِرَاحُ مُشْكِلَةَ ازْدِحَامِ الْمُرُورِ الْمُتَزَايِدَةَ فِي وَسَطِ الْمَدِينَةِ

questions.text: Which phrase introduces a proposed solution formally, "it is recommended that..."?
A well-formed proposal typically includes:
options: Problem statement, proposed solution, justification, and an implementation plan
Only a list of complaints with no solution
A single sentence with no supporting detail
Personal opinions unrelated to the problem
questions.answer: Problem statement, proposed solution, justification, and an implementation plan

questions.text: Which sentence justifies a proposal with a cost-benefit statement, "the initial investment will be offset by long-term savings"?
options: سَيُعَوَّضُ الِاسْتِثْمَارُ الْأَوَّلِيُّ بِالْوَفْرِ عَلَى الْمَدَى الْبَعِيدِ
questions.answer: سَيُعَوَّضُ الِاسْتِثْمَارُ الْأَوَّلِيُّ بِالْوَفْرِ عَلَى الْمَدَى الْبَعِيدِ

questions.text: Which sentence outlines a concrete implementation timeline, "The first phase will be completed within six months"?
options: سَتُنْجَزُ الْمَرْحَلَةُ الْأُولَى خِلَالَ سِتَّةِ أَشْهُرٍ
questions.answer: سَتُنْجَزُ الْمَرْحَلَةُ الْأُولَى خِلَالَ سِتَّةِ أَشْهُرٍ

stages.title: At-Ta'bīr 'an as-Sababiyyah al-Mu'aqqadah — Complex Causality
stages.description: Expressing multi-layered causes, effects, and feedback loops

questions.text: Which sentence expresses a chain of causality with more than one link: "Rising temperatures melt glaciers, which in turn raises sea levels, threatening coastal cities"?
options: يُذِيبُ ارْتِفَاعُ دَرَجَاتِ الْحَرَارَةِ الْأَنْهَارَ الْجَلِيدِيَّةَ، مِمَّا يَرْفَعُ مُسْتَوَى الْبِحَارِ بِدَوْرِهِ، وَيُهَدِّدُ الْمُدُنَ السَّاحِلِيَّةَ
دَرَجَاتُ الْحَرَارَةِ لَا تُؤَثِّرُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِطْلَاقًا
الْأَنْهَارُ الْجَلِيدِيَّةُ لَا عَلَاقَةَ لَهَا بِمُسْتَوَى الْبِحَارِ
الْمُدُنُ السَّاحِلِيَّةُ آمِنَةٌ تَمَامًا فِي كُلِّ الْأَحْوَالِ
questions.answer: يُذِيبُ ارْتِفَاعُ دَرَجَاتِ الْحَرَارَةِ الْأَنْهَارَ الْجَلِيدِيَّةَ، مِمَّا يَرْفَعُ مُسْتَوَى الْبِحَارِ بِدَوْرِهِ، وَيُهَدِّدُ الْمُدُنَ السَّاحِلِيَّةَ

questions.text: Which phrase distinguishes a root cause from a contributing factor, "the underlying cause, as opposed to a mere contributing factor, is..."?
options: السَّبَبُ الْجَذْرِيُّ، بِخِلَافِ الْعَامِلِ الْمُسَاهِمِ فَقَط، هُوَ...
كُلُّ الْأَسْبَابِ مُتَسَاوِيَةٌ فِي الْأَهَمِّيَّةِ دَائِمًا
لَا يُوجَدُ أَيُّ سَبَبٍ جَذْرِيٍّ لِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ
الْعَوَامِلُ الْمُسَاهِمَةُ هِيَ نَفْسُهَا السَّبَبُ الْجَذْرِيُّ دَائِمًا
questions.answer: السَّبَبُ الْجَذْرِيُّ، بِخِلَافِ الْعَامِلِ الْمُسَاهِمِ فَقَط، هُوَ...

questions.text: Which sentence describes a feedback loop, where an effect further intensifies its own cause: "As trust declines, cooperation weakens, which further erodes trust"?
options: كُلَّمَا تَرَاجَعَتِ الثِّقَةُ، ضَعُفَ التَّعَاوُنُ، مِمَّا يُقَوِّضُ الثِّقَةَ أَكْثَرَ
الثِّقَةُ وَالتَّعَاوُنُ لَا عَلَاقَةَ بَيْنَهُمَا عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
التَّعَاوُنُ يَزْدَادُ دَائِمًا بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الثِّقَةِ
questions.answer: كُلَّمَا تَرَاجَعَتِ الثِّقَةُ، ضَعُفَ التَّعَاوُنُ، مِمَّا يُقَوِّضُ الثِّقَةَ أَكْثَرَ

questions.text: Which phrase correctly expresses a secondary, less direct effect, "an indirect consequence of this is..."?
Why is it important, in advanced writing, to distinguish correlation from causation?
options: Because two things occurring together does not necessarily mean one causes the other, and conflating them weakens an argument
Because correlation and causation always mean exactly the same thing
Because causation is never relevant to argumentation
Because only correlation matters in formal writing
questions.answer: Because two things occurring together does not necessarily mean one causes the other, and conflating them weakens an argument

stages.title: Al-Khitām al-Mu'aththir — The Powerful Conclusion
stages.description: Closing a piece of writing with impact, beyond mere restatement

questions.text: Which conclusion goes beyond restating the thesis by connecting the topic to a broader implication: "This issue, then, is not just about policy — it is about the kind of society we choose to build"?
options: إِذَنْ، هَذِهِ الْقَضِيَّةُ لَيْسَتْ مُجَرَّدَ سِيَاسَةٍ، بَلْ هِيَ عَنْ نَوْعِ الْمُجْتَمَعِ الَّذِي نَخْتَارُ بِنَاءَهُ
هَذِهِ الْقَضِيَّةُ سِيَاسَةٌ فَقَط وَلَا شَيْءَ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ
لَنْ أَتَحَدَّثَ عَنِ الْمُجْتَمَعِ عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
questions.answer: إِذَنْ، هَذِهِ الْقَضِيَّةُ لَيْسَتْ مُجَرَّدَ سِيَاسَةٍ، بَلْ هِيَ عَنْ نَوْعِ الْمُجْتَمَعِ الَّذِي نَخْتَارُ بِنَاءَهُ

questions.text: A weak conclusion most commonly fails by:
options: Merely repeating the introduction word-for-word with no new insight
Ending with a forward-looking or thought-provoking statement
Tying the argument back to its broader significance
Leaving the reader with a clear sense of resolution
questions.answer: Merely repeating the introduction word-for-word with no new insight

questions.text: Which closing sentence uses a forward-looking call to reflection, "The question now is not whether change is needed, but how soon we are willing to act"?
options: السُّؤَالُ الْآنَ لَيْسَ إِنْ كَانَ التَّغْيِيرُ ضَرُورِيًّا، بَلْ إِلَى أَيِّ مَدَى نَحْنُ مُسْتَعِدُّونَ لِلتَّحَرُّكِ سَرِيعًا
لَا سُؤَالَ يَسْتَحِقُّ طَرْحَهُ فِي هَذَا الْمَوْضُوعِ
questions.answer: السُّؤَالُ الْآنَ لَيْسَ إِنْ كَانَ التَّغْيِيرُ ضَرُورِيًّا، بَلْ إِلَى أَيِّ مَدَى نَحْنُ مُسْتَعِدُّونَ لِلتَّحَرُّكِ سَرِيعًا

questions.text: Which phrase effectively signals the final synthesis of an essay's ideas, "taken together, these points demonstrate that..."?
options: وَإِذَا أَخَذْنَا هَذِهِ النِّقَاطَ مَعًا، فَإِنَّهَا تُبَيِّنُ أَنَّ...
هَذِهِ النِّقَاطُ لَا عَلَاقَةَ بَيْنَهَا إِطْلَاقًا
لَا يُمْكِنُ الْجَمْعُ بَيْنَ أَيِّ نِقَاطٍ
questions.answer: وَإِذَا أَخَذْنَا هَذِهِ النِّقَاطَ مَعًا، فَإِنَّهَا تُبَيِّنُ أَنَّ...

questions.text: Why should a powerful conclusion avoid introducing entirely new arguments?
options: New arguments at that point cannot be supported with evidence and disrupt the essay's sense of closure
New arguments always strengthen a conclusion regardless of support
Conclusions are the only appropriate place for new evidence
It doesn't matter where arguments are introduced
questions.answer: New arguments at that point cannot be supported with evidence and disrupt the essay's sense of closure

stages.title: An-Naqd al-Bannā' — Constructive Criticism
stages.description: Giving critical feedback that is honest yet respectful and useful

questions.text: Which sentence delivers constructive criticism respectfully: "The idea is promising, though the second section would benefit from clearer examples"?
options: الْفِكْرَةُ وَاعِدَةٌ، وَإِنْ كَانَ الْقِسْمُ الثَّانِي سَيَسْتَفِيدُ مِنْ أَمْثِلَةٍ أَوْضَحَ
هَذِهِ الْفِكْرَةُ سَيِّئَةٌ تَمَامًا وَلَا فَائِدَةَ مِنْهَا
لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ إِبْدَاءَ أَيِّ رَأْيٍ فِي هَذَا الْعَمَلِ
الْقِسْمُ الثَّانِي لَا يُقْرَأُ عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
questions.answer: الْفِكْرَةُ وَاعِدَةٌ، وَإِنْ كَانَ الْقِسْمُ الثَّانِي سَيَسْتَفِيدُ مِنْ أَمْثِلَةٍ أَوْضَحَ

questions.text: A well-balanced piece of constructive criticism typically:
options: Pairs specific praise with specific, actionable suggestions for improvement
Focuses only on flaws with no acknowledgment of strengths
Avoids being specific to spare the person's feelings
Uses vague generalities like 'it's just not good'
questions.answer: Pairs specific praise with specific, actionable suggestions for improvement

questions.text: Which phrase softens criticism while remaining clear, "one area that could be strengthened is..."?
options: هَذَا الْجَانِبُ فَاشِلٌ تَمَامًا وَبِلَا رَجْعَةٍ
لَا يُمْكِنُ تَحْسِينُ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ هُنَا
كُلُّ شَيْءٍ هُنَا مِثَالِيٌّ بِلَا اسْتِثْنَاءٍ

questions.text: Which sentence offers an actionable, specific suggestion rather than a vague complaint: "Adding a brief summary at the start of each section would help readers follow the argument"?
options: إِضَافَةُ مُلَخَّصٍ مُوجَزٍ فِي بِدَايَةِ كُلِّ قِسْمٍ سَتُسَاعِدُ الْقُرَّاءَ عَلَى مُتَابَعَةِ الِاسْتِدْلَالِ
الْعَمَلُ غَيْرُ مَفْهُومٍ إِطْلَاقًا وَلَا حَلَّ لِذَلِكَ
لَا أَعْرِفُ مَا الَّذِي يَنْقُصُ هَذَا الْعَمَلَ
الْقُرَّاءُ لَنْ يَفْهَمُوا هَذَا الْعَمَلَ أَبَدًا
questions.answer: إِضَافَةُ مُلَخَّصٍ مُوجَزٍ فِي بِدَايَةِ كُلِّ قِسْمٍ سَتُسَاعِدُ الْقُرَّاءَ عَلَى مُتَابَعَةِ الِاسْتِدْلَالِ

questions.text: Why is tone especially important when delivering criticism in formal or professional contexts?
options: A respectful tone keeps the recipient receptive to the feedback rather than defensive
Tone has no effect on how feedback is received
Harsh tone always leads to faster improvement
Formal contexts require no consideration of tone at all
questions.answer: A respectful tone keeps the recipient receptive to the feedback rather than defensive

stages.title: Al-Murāsalāt ar-Rasmiyyah al-Mutaqaddimah — Advanced Formal Correspondence
stages.description: Complex formal letters: complaints, applications, official requests

questions.text: Which opening is appropriate for a formal letter of complaint, "I am writing to express my concern regarding..."?
options: أَكْتُبُ إِلَيْكُمْ لِأُعَبِّرَ عَنْ قَلَقِي بِخُصُوصِ...
questions.answer: أَكْتُبُ إِلَيْكُمْ لِأُعَبِّرَ عَنْ قَلَقِي بِخُصُوصِ...

questions.text: Which sentence formally requests corrective action in a complaint letter, "I would appreciate it if this matter could be resolved promptly"?
options: سَأَكُونُ مُمْتَنًّا لَوْ أَمْكَنَ حَلُّ هَذِهِ الْمَسْأَلَةِ عَلَى وَجْهِ السُّرْعَةِ
لَا يُهِمُّنِي مَتَى تُحَلُّ هَذِهِ الْمَسْأَلَةُ
questions.answer: سَأَكُونُ مُمْتَنًّا لَوْ أَمْكَنَ حَلُّ هَذِهِ الْمَسْأَلَةِ عَلَى وَجْهِ السُّرْعَةِ

questions.text: Which sentence is appropriate for a formal job application letter, "I believe my experience and qualifications make me a strong candidate for this position"?
options: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ خِبْرَتِي وَمُؤَهِّلَاتِي تَجْعَلُنِي مُرَشَّحًا قَوِيًّا لِهَذَا الْمَنْصِبِ
لَيْسَتْ لَدَيَّ أَيَّةُ خِبْرَةٍ فِي أَيِّ شَيْءٍ
لَا أَعْرِفُ لِمَاذَا أَتَقَدَّمُ لِهَذَا الْمَنْصِبِ
هَذَا الْمَنْصِبُ لَا يُهِمُّنِي عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
questions.answer: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ خِبْرَتِي وَمُؤَهِّلَاتِي تَجْعَلُنِي مُرَشَّحًا قَوِيًّا لِهَذَا الْمَنْصِبِ

questions.text: Which formal closing appropriately precedes a signature in an official Arabic letter, "Please accept my highest regards"?
What distinguishes advanced formal correspondence from a basic formal letter?
options: It handles more complex situations (complaints, applications, official requests) with nuanced justification and precise register
It uses casual greetings and abbreviations throughout
It avoids any structure or formal opening/closing
It is always shorter than a basic formal letter
questions.answer: It handles more complex situations (complaints, applications, official requests) with nuanced justification and precise register

stages.title: At-Ta'bīr 'an al-Iḥtimāl wat-Taraddud — Expressing Probability & Hesitation
stages.description: Nuanced language for likelihood, doubt, and qualified certainty

questions.text: Which sentence expresses a high degree of probability, "it is highly likely that prices will rise next year"?
options: مِنَ الْمُرَجَّحِ جِدًّا أَنْ تَرْتَفِعَ الْأَسْعَارُ الْعَامَ الْمُقْبِلَ
مِنَ الْمُسْتَحِيلِ أَنْ تَرْتَفِعَ الْأَسْعَارُ أَبَدًا
لَا أَحَدَ يَعْرِفُ شَيْئًا عَنِ الْأَسْعَارِ
questions.answer: مِنَ الْمُرَجَّحِ جِدًّا أَنْ تَرْتَفِعَ الْأَسْعَارُ الْعَامَ الْمُقْبِلَ

questions.text: Which phrase expresses cautious hesitation rather than firm certainty, "it seems, though I cannot be entirely certain, that..."?
options: يَبْدُو، وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لَا أَجْزِمُ تَمَامًا، أَنَّ...
أَنَا مُتَأَكِّدٌ تَمَامًا وَبِلَا أَيِّ شَكٍّ أَنَّ...
مِنَ الْمُسْتَحِيلِ أَنْ يَكُونَ هَذَا صَحِيحًا...
لَا أَعْرِفُ وَلَنْ أُحَاوِلَ أَنْ أَعْرِفَ...
questions.answer: يَبْدُو، وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لَا أَجْزِمُ تَمَامًا، أَنَّ...

questions.text: Which sentence expresses low probability, "it is unlikely, though not impossible, that the plan will succeed"?
options: مِنَ غَيْرِ الْمُرَجَّحِ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مُسْتَحِيلًا، أَنْ تَنْجَحَ الْخُطَّةُ
مِنَ الْمُؤَكَّدِ تَمَامًا أَنَّ الْخُطَّةَ سَتَنْجَحُ
لَا عَلَاقَةَ لِلْخُطَّةِ بِالنَّجَاحِ أَوِ الْفَشَلِ
questions.answer: مِنَ غَيْرِ الْمُرَجَّحِ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مُسْتَحِيلًا، أَنْ تَنْجَحَ الْخُطَّةُ

questions.text: Which modal expression correctly conveys a qualified obligation, "it may be necessary to reconsider the approach"?
options: قَدْ يَكُونُ مِنَ الضَّرُورِيِّ إِعَادَةُ النَّظَرِ فِي النَّهْجِ
مِنَ الْمُسْتَحِيلِ إِعَادَةُ النَّظَرِ فِي أَيِّ شَيْءٍ
لَا حَاجَةَ لِإِعَادَةِ النَّظَرِ فِي شَيْءٍ عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
النَّهْجُ الْحَالِيُّ مِثَالِيٌّ بِلَا أَيِّ عَيْبٍ
questions.answer: قَدْ يَكُونُ مِنَ الضَّرُورِيِّ إِعَادَةُ النَّظَرِ فِي النَّهْجِ

questions.text: Why does advanced Arabic expression favor graded expressions of probability (e.g. 'highly likely', 'unlikely but possible') over blanket certainty or denial?
options: Because they represent nuanced, honest positions more accurately than absolute claims
Because certainty is always the more sophisticated choice
Because graded expressions are only used in casual speech
Because Arabic lacks vocabulary for expressing certainty
questions.answer: Because they represent nuanced, honest positions more accurately than absolute claims

stages.title: Al-Munāẓarah — Debate Expression
stages.description: Language for structured debate: framing, rebuttal, and closing statements

questions.text: Which sentence formally states a debate position, "This house believes that social media does more harm than good"?
options: يَرَى هَذَا الْمَجْلِسُ أَنَّ وَسَائِلَ التَّوَاصُلِ الِاجْتِمَاعِيِّ تُلْحِقُ ضَرَرًا أَكْبَرَ مِنْ نَفْعِهَا
وَسَائِلُ التَّوَاصُلِ لَا رَأْيَ فِيهَا لِأَحَدٍ
هَذَا الْمَجْلِسُ لَا يَرَى شَيْئًا عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
questions.answer: يَرَى هَذَا الْمَجْلِسُ أَنَّ وَسَائِلَ التَّوَاصُلِ الِاجْتِمَاعِيِّ تُلْحِقُ ضَرَرًا أَكْبَرَ مِنْ نَفْعِهَا

questions.text: Which phrase is used to directly challenge an opponent's point in debate, "I must take issue with my opponent's claim that..."?
options: لَا بُدَّ لِي أَنْ أَعْتَرِضَ عَلَى زَعْمِ خَصْمِي بِأَنَّ...
أُوَافِقُ خَصْمِي تَمَامًا فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
لَا رَأْيَ لِي فِي كَلَامِ خَصْمِي
questions.answer: لَا بُدَّ لِي أَنْ أَعْتَرِضَ عَلَى زَعْمِ خَصْمِي بِأَنَّ...

questions.text: Which sentence functions as an effective closing statement in a debate, summarizing the strongest point: "In conclusion, the evidence we have presented today leaves no doubt as to where the balance of argument lies"?
options: فِي الْخِتَامِ، لَا تَدَعُ الْأَدِلَّةُ الَّتِي قَدَّمْنَاهَا الْيَوْمَ مَجَالًا لِلشَّكِّ فِي أَيْنَ تَكْمُنُ كِفَّةُ الرَّاجِحِ
لَا أَدْرِي مَاذَا أَقُولُ فِي الْخِتَامِ
questions.answer: فِي الْخِتَامِ، لَا تَدَعُ الْأَدِلَّةُ الَّتِي قَدَّمْنَاهَا الْيَوْمَ مَجَالًا لِلشَّكِّ فِي أَيْنَ تَكْمُنُ كِفَّةُ الرَّاجِحِ

questions.text: In formal debate, what is the primary purpose of a rebuttal round?
options: To directly respond to and weaken the opposing team's specific arguments
To introduce entirely unrelated new topics
To repeat one's own opening statement verbatim
To concede the debate to the opposing side
questions.answer: To directly respond to and weaken the opposing team's specific arguments

questions.text: Which phrase politely but firmly maintains one's position after a challenge, "I stand by my original point, for the following reason..."?
options: أَتَرَاجَعُ عَنْ رَأْيِي فَوْرًا بِلَا أَيِّ سَبَبٍ
لَا مَوْقِفَ لِي فِي هَذَا النِّقَاشِ
خَصْمِي عَلَى حَقٍّ تَمَامًا وَأَنَا مُخْطِئٌ

stages.title: Uslūb al-Kitābah al-Ṣaḥafiyyah — Journalistic Writing Style
stages.description: News-style reporting: lede, inverted pyramid, and neutral tone

questions.text: Which sentence functions as an effective news lede, answering who/what/when/where concisely: "City officials announced Monday a new plan to expand public transportation across the capital"?
options: أَعْلَنَ مَسْؤُولُو الْمَدِينَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ عَنْ خُطَّةٍ جَدِيدَةٍ لِتَوْسِيعِ النَّقْلِ الْعَامِّ فِي أَنْحَاءِ الْعَاصِمَةِ
شَيْءٌ مَا حَدَثَ فِي مَكَانٍ مَا فِي وَقْتٍ مَا
questions.answer: أَعْلَنَ مَسْؤُولُو الْمَدِينَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ عَنْ خُطَّةٍ جَدِيدَةٍ لِتَوْسِيعِ النَّقْلِ الْعَامِّ فِي أَنْحَاءِ الْعَاصِمَةِ

questions.text: The 'inverted pyramid' structure in journalism means:
options: Presenting the most important information first, followed by supporting details in decreasing order of importance
Saving the most important information for the very last sentence
Writing in strict chronological order regardless of importance
Randomly ordering facts throughout the article
questions.answer: Presenting the most important information first, followed by supporting details in decreasing order of importance

questions.text: Which sentence maintains neutral journalistic tone rather than inserting personal opinion: "Officials stated that the project will be completed by next year"?
options: صَرَّحَ الْمَسْؤُولُونَ بِأَنَّ الْمَشْرُوعَ سَيَكْتَمِلُ بِحُلُولِ الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ
أَعْتَقِدُ شَخْصِيًّا أَنَّ هَذَا الْمَشْرُوعَ سَيِّئٌ جِدًّا
هَذَا الْمَشْرُوعُ سَيَفْشَلُ حَتْمًا فِي رَأْيِي
questions.answer: صَرَّحَ الْمَسْؤُولُونَ بِأَنَّ الْمَشْرُوعَ سَيَكْتَمِلُ بِحُلُولِ الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ

questions.text: Which phrase correctly attributes a claim to its source, essential in journalistic writing, "according to a statement released by the ministry"?
Why do journalists avoid emotionally loaded language in straight news reporting?
options: To maintain objectivity and let readers form their own judgments from the facts presented
Because emotional language is always factually inaccurate
Because news articles must be as long as possible
questions.answer: To maintain objectivity and let readers form their own judgments from the facts presented

stages.title: Muḥāḍarah Qaṣīrah — Short Lecture / Presentation
stages.description: Structuring and delivering a short informative presentation

questions.text: Which sentence effectively opens a short lecture by stating its purpose, "Today, I will explain the key stages of the water cycle"?
options: سَأَشْرَحُ الْيَوْمَ الْمَرَاحِلَ الرَّئِيسِيَّةَ لِدَوْرَةِ الْمَاءِ
لَنْ أَتَحَدَّثَ عَنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ مُحَدَّدٍ
questions.answer: سَأَشْرَحُ الْيَوْمَ الْمَرَاحِلَ الرَّئِيسِيَّةَ لِدَوْرَةِ الْمَاءِ

questions.text: Which phrase signals a transition to the next point in a structured presentation, "moving on to the second point..."?
options: لَنْ أَنْتَقِلَ إِلَى أَيِّ نُقْطَةٍ أُخْرَى...

questions.text: Which sentence invites audience engagement appropriately during a presentation, "Are there any questions before I move on?"?
options: هَلْ هُنَاكَ أَيَّةُ أَسْئِلَةٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنْتَقِلَ؟
لَا أَحَدَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ شَيْئًا
questions.answer: هَلْ هُنَاكَ أَيَّةُ أَسْئِلَةٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنْتَقِلَ؟

questions.text: Which sentence summarizes key takeaways at the end of a presentation, "To summarize, we have covered three main stages today"?
options: وَلِتَلْخِيصِ مَا سَبَقَ، تَنَاوَلْنَا الْيَوْمَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَاحِلَ رَئِيسِيَّةٍ
questions.answer: وَلِتَلْخِيصِ مَا سَبَقَ، تَنَاوَلْنَا الْيَوْمَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَاحِلَ رَئِيسِيَّةٍ

questions.text: Why is signposting (explicit transitional language) especially important in a spoken presentation compared to written text?
options: Listeners cannot re-read a spoken passage, so clear verbal cues help them track structure in real time
Signposting is only useful in written text, never speech
Spoken presentations should have no discernible structure
Audiences always remember every detail regardless of structure
questions.answer: Listeners cannot re-read a spoken passage, so clear verbal cues help them track structure in real time

stages.title: Murāja'ah — Advanced Capstone Review
stages.description: The capstone review: argumentation, rebuttal, register, and synthesis combined

questions.text: Which passage best combines a thesis, evidence, and a concessive rebuttal on remote work: "Remote work boosts productivity, as several studies confirm; critics warn of isolation, yet this can be mitigated through regular team check-ins"?
options: يُعَزِّزُ الْعَمَلُ عَنْ بُعْدٍ الْإِنْتَاجِيَّةَ، كَمَا تُؤَكِّدُ عِدَّةُ دِرَاسَاتٍ؛ وَيُحَذِّرُ الْمُنْتَقِدُونَ مِنَ الْعُزْلَةِ، غَيْرَ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ يُمْكِنُ تَخْفِيفُهُ عَبْرَ لِقَاءَاتٍ دَوْرِيَّةٍ لِلْفَرِيقِ
الْعَمَلُ عَنْ بُعْدٍ لَا فَائِدَةَ مِنْهُ عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
لَا تُوجَدُ أَيَّةُ دِرَاسَاتٍ عَنِ الْعَمَلِ عَنْ بُعْدٍ
الْعُزْلَةُ لَا عَلَاقَةَ لَهَا بِالْعَمَلِ عَنْ بُعْدٍ
questions.answer: يُعَزِّزُ الْعَمَلُ عَنْ بُعْدٍ الْإِنْتَاجِيَّةَ، كَمَا تُؤَكِّدُ عِدَّةُ دِرَاسَاتٍ؛ وَيُحَذِّرُ الْمُنْتَقِدُونَ مِنَ الْعُزْلَةِ، غَيْرَ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ يُمْكِنُ تَخْفِيفُهُ عَبْرَ لِقَاءَاتٍ دَوْرِيَّةٍ لِلْفَرِيقِ

questions.text: Which sentence demonstrates appropriate academic register while citing a source in a formal essay: "As noted by several economists, inflation disproportionately affects lower-income households"?
options: كَمَا لَاحَظَ عَدَدٌ مِنَ الِاقْتِصَادِيِّينَ، فَإِنَّ التَّضَخُّمَ يُؤَثِّرُ بِشَكْلٍ غَيْرِ مُتَنَاسِبٍ عَلَى الْأُسَرِ ذَاتِ الدَّخْلِ الْمَحْدُودِ
التَّضَخُّمُ لَا يُؤَثِّرُ عَلَى أَحَدٍ إِطْلَاقًا
لَا اقْتِصَادِيَّ لَاحَظَ شَيْئًا عَنِ التَّضَخُّمِ
الْأُسَرُ ذَاتُ الدَّخْلِ الْمَحْدُودِ غَيْرُ مَوْجُودَةٍ
questions.answer: كَمَا لَاحَظَ عَدَدٌ مِنَ الِاقْتِصَادِيِّينَ، فَإِنَّ التَّضَخُّمَ يُؤَثِّرُ بِشَكْلٍ غَيْرِ مُتَنَاسِبٍ عَلَى الْأُسَرِ ذَاتِ الدَّخْلِ الْمَحْدُودِ

questions.text: Which closing statement effectively synthesizes an essay's argument while connecting it to broader significance: "Ultimately, how we address this challenge today will define the opportunities available to the next generation"?
options: فِي نِهَايَةِ الْمَطَافِ، فَإِنَّ كَيْفِيَّةَ تَعَامُلِنَا مَعَ هَذَا التَّحَدِّي الْيَوْمَ سَتُحَدِّدُ الْفُرَصَ الْمُتَاحَةَ لِلْجِيلِ الْقَادِمِ
هَذَا التَّحَدِّي لَا يَهُمُّ أَحَدًا عَلَى الْإِطْلَاقِ
الْجِيلُ الْقَادِمُ لَنْ يَتَأَثَّرَ بِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ نَفْعَلُهُ
questions.answer: فِي نِهَايَةِ الْمَطَافِ، فَإِنَّ كَيْفِيَّةَ تَعَامُلِنَا مَعَ هَذَا التَّحَدِّي الْيَوْمَ سَتُحَدِّدُ الْفُرَصَ الْمُتَاحَةَ لِلْجِيلِ الْقَادِمِ

questions.text: Which sentence shows a formal register shift appropriate for a ministerial speech versus a casual talk, "It is with great honor that I address this distinguished assembly today"?
options: يَشْرُفُنِي عَظِيمَ الشَّرَفِ أَنْ أُخَاطِبَ هَذَا الْجَمْعَ الْمُوَقَّرَ الْيَوْمَ
questions.answer: يَشْرُفُنِي عَظِيمَ الشَّرَفِ أَنْ أُخَاطِبَ هَذَا الْجَمْعَ الْمُوَقَّرَ الْيَوْمَ

questions.text: Across the Advanced level, what is the overarching skill progression compared to Intermediate?
options: Moving from structured multi-sentence paragraphs to full argumentative essays, formal oratory, critical analysis, and precise academic/journalistic register
Simply repeating intermediate-level sentences with harder vocabulary
Abandoning structure entirely in favor of free association
Focusing only on memorizing isolated advanced words with no composition
questions.answer: Moving from structured multi-sentence paragraphs to full argumentative essays, formal oratory, critical analysis, and precise academic/journalistic register

questions.text: Which sentence best demonstrates mastery of advanced connectors, register shift, and rebuttal together: "Although some claim tradition should never change, history shows that societies which adapt thoughtfully — without abandoning their roots — are the ones that endure"?
options: عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ زَعْمِ الْبَعْضِ أَنَّ التَّقَالِيدَ يَنْبَغِي أَلَّا تَتَغَيَّرَ أَبَدًا، يُظْهِرُ التَّارِيخُ أَنَّ الْمُجْتَمَعَاتِ الَّتِي تَتَكَيَّفُ بِتَبَصُّرٍ، دُونَ التَّخَلِّي عَنْ جُذُورِهَا، هِيَ الَّتِي تَدُومُ
التَّقَالِيدُ لَا تَتَغَيَّرُ أَبَدًا وَلَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ تَتَغَيَّرَ
التَّارِيخُ لَا يُعَلِّمُنَا شَيْئًا عَنِ الْمُجْتَمَعَاتِ
الْمُجْتَمَعَاتُ الَّتِي تَتَكَيَّفُ تَخْسَرُ جُذُورَهَا حَتْمًا
questions.answer: عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ زَعْمِ الْبَعْضِ أَنَّ التَّقَالِيدَ يَنْبَغِي أَلَّا تَتَغَيَّرَ أَبَدًا، يُظْهِرُ التَّارِيخُ أَنَّ الْمُجْتَمَعَاتِ الَّتِي تَتَكَيَّفُ بِتَبَصُّرٍ، دُونَ التَّخَلِّي عَنْ جُذُورِهَا، هِيَ الَّتِي تَدُومُ
